title: RESKit administrative boundary test fixtures
description: The two administrative polygons the test fixtures are built around: Staedteregion Aachen and the city of Bulawayo, Zimbabwe. Both replaced GADM originals on 2026-09-09; see ethos:license_note.
ethos:derivation:
aachenShapefile.* is the Kreis with AGS 05334 from BKG VG250, reprojected from UTM32 to EPSG:4326 and written as a 5-part multipolygon. Symmetric difference against the upstream feature is exactly zero.
cityBulawayoInZimbabwa.* is the province with pcode ZW10 from the OCHA/ZIMSTAT Common Operational Dataset, already in EPSG:4326. Symmetric difference against upstream exactly zero.
Each feature carries `source` and `licence` in its own attribute table, so the terms travel with the geometry rather than only with this descriptor.
